Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Reports a command that failed on the server at the other end of a [PgReplicationConnection](/api/ankus.pgreplicationconnection/).

```csharp
public sealed class PgRemoteException : Exception, ISerializable
```

The failure happened on the server, so this backend's transaction is unaffected and the connection stays usable.

Inheritance: [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object), [Exception](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.exception)

Implements: [ISerializable](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.runtime.serialization.iserializable)
